description: Diagnostic module that queries mcp_signal_scores and mcp_signal_enrichments to diagnose why permission_scope, temporal_stability, and tool_description_safety each produce only 4 distinct values. Must: (1) count distinct scores per signal_type, (2) sample 10 rows per signal showing score + evidence_blob, (3) check if enrichment modules are being called by inspecting mcp_signal_enrichments row counts, (4) identify if scores cluster in narrow ranges. Outputs findings to diagnostic report via write_service/execute. Does NOT fix anything—pure diagnostic. Targeted at understanding why spec requirement 'BAD SIGNAL = SAME SIGNAL across all inputs' triggers for these three signals despite enrichment modules existing.
